source_location: main p.562 (PDF page 6), Fig. 5 (H2 adsorption at 77 K, 0-1200 mbar), series MWNT2 (small dashes on grey line)
notes: archive: fig5_MWNT2.json. uptake_wt_pct is W1 computed from the digitized mmol/g (the figure's right axis 'H2 storage (wt%)' is a fixed 0.2 x mmol/g scale and was not read separately). Fig. 5 axes: P (mbar) converted to bar; left axis V Ads (mmol g-1). MWNT2 markers are small black dashes on a grey line, ~4 px above the MWNT asterisks; band half-width 1.0-1.6 px. BET evaluated 'as described elsewhere (Parra et al. 1995)'; no P/P0 range stated. Degassed in situ at 523 K under vacuum before H2 isotherms (printed 523 K; duration and end pressure not stated).
